name: Overload Wild Deposits
tooltip:
Overload Wild Deposits
5 yd range
2.5 sec cast
Overloading a Wild ore deposit will challenge an Avatar of Nalorakk, the Bear Loa, to a duel. Should you succeed, the Avatar will grant a boon to your Perception for a limited time. Should you fail...best not to think about that.

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
